newsitem.title: SWEDEN: TI Group bids 189 mln stg for Forsheda.
newsitem.headline: TI Group bids 189 mln stg for Forsheda.

text.p: Britain's TI Group said on Monday it had bid 189 million pounds sterling for Swedish polymer sealing group Forsheda in a move it said would double the size of TI's polymer technology operation.
TI said in a statement it would pay 247.50 crowns cash for each A-series share in Forsheda, and 225 crowns cash for each B-share.

It said the offer implied a premium of 38.9 percent per B-series share on the price of 162 crowns per share last paid on September 30, the day on which trade in Forsheda was suspended on the Stockholm bourse.
The premium over the average price paid over the past month for the unlisted A-series share was 44.2 percent, TI said.
It said Forsheda's board recommended shareholders in the Swedish company accept the offer, something that was later confirmed in a statement by Forsheda itself.

TI said the premium of 10 percent it offered per A-series share in relation to its bid for the B-series share was to compensate the A-series shareholders -- which include the Agora Holding AB group -- for the higher voting rights attracted by the A-series issue.
"TI has received an unretractable undertaking from the Agora Group to accept the offer for all of their shareholding in Forsheda," TI said.
The Agora Group controls a total of 20.6 percent of the share capital in Forsheda and around 63.6 percent of the votes.
